menu_options.bambu_device: Bambu Lab (through the Bambu Lab integration)

electricity.title: Smart plug
electricity.description: The plug the printer is connected to. A plug without energy metering works too: there is just no consumption or cost.

klipper.title: Klipper printer
klipper.description: Type the printer's IP address. Port, name and web interface are filled in automatically and can be changed later in Configure.

data_description.host: e.g. 192.168.1.89 (add :port only if Moonraker does not use 7125)

bambu_device.title: Bambu Lab printer
bambu_device.description: Select the printer from the Bambu Lab (ha-bambulab) integration. A direct LAN connection that needs no other integration is planned.

bambu.title: Printer entities
bambu.description: {found} entities were detected for {printer}. Check or correct them.

data_description.job_name_entity: Used to tell two prints apart.

klipper_auth.title: API key needed
klipper_auth.description: The printer at {host} only accepts connections with a Moonraker API key. See "Authorization" in the Moonraker documentation for how to get it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Klipper printer found
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add **{name}** ({host})? Next you pick the smart plug it is connected to.

bambu_lan.title: Bambu Lab printer (LAN)
bambu_lan.description: Everything is on the printer's screen: Settings → WLAN / Network (IP address and access code) and Settings → Device (serial number). If the printer refuses the connection, turn on LAN Only mode on the printer. Developer Mode is optional: only needed to send commands such as pause or the chamber light.

data_description.printer_name: Filled with the printer's model (from the serial number). Change it if you like.
data_description.access_code: 8 characters, shown on the printer's screen.

reauth_confirm.title: New access code
reauth_confirm.description: {name} refused its access code. It changes when LAN Only mode is turned off and on again. Type the new one, shown on the printer's LAN Only page.

data_description.host: Shown on the same page. Change it only if it changed too.

data.price_entity: Price entity (instead of a fixed price)

data_description.switch_entity: The switch that powers the printer.
data_description.energy_entity: Optional. Recommended: a cumulative meter is exact, even across restarts.
data_description.price_entity: Optional: a sensor or input_number whose price may change (tariffs). Used instead of the fixed price.
data_description.price_per_kwh: What you pay per kWh, e.g. 0.16. Needed for the cost.

data.auto_off_minutes: Turn the printer off after a print (minutes)

data_description.auto_off_minutes: After a print ends (finished, cancelled or failed) and this long without a new one, the printer is turned off safely: nozzle below 80 °C, its computer shut down, the plug cut once it stops answering. 0 = never. Needs a smart plug.
data_description.babystep: Baby steps: the card shows buttons that move the nozzle up or down while printing (SET_GCODE_OFFSET), at most 1 mm from 0. Only when Klipper knows the command.
data_description.babystep_save: Adds a Save button that keeps the offset (Z_OFFSET_APPLY_PROBE or Z_OFFSET_APPLY_ENDSTOP). Run SAVE_CONFIG yourself when the printer is idle. Off by default.
data_description.ssh_username: Advanced: only for a printer whose Moonraker cannot shut its computer down. The Elegoo Centauri Carbon needs nothing here: it is recognised and shut down over SSH as root by itself. Leave empty to not use SSH.
data_description.ssh_password: Optional. Leave empty to keep the stored one (or for a login without a password).
data_description.ssh_private_key: Optional, instead of the password (OpenSSH format). Leave empty to keep the stored one.
data_description.ssh_command: Run on the printer to shut it down, for example poweroff or sudo poweroff.

klipper.title: Klipper printer
klipper.description: Change the connection. The printer keeps its history and entities.

data_description.printer_name: Leave empty to use the printer's host name.
data_description.port: 7125 unless you changed it in moonraker.conf.
data_description.api_key: Only if Moonraker requires one (trusted_clients not set for Home Assistant).
data_description.web_url: Mainsail or Fluidd. Leave empty to use the printer's IP address (http://IP/). Opens with "Visit" on the device page.

bambu_lan.title: Bambu Lab printer (LAN)
bambu_lan.description: Change the connection. The printer keeps its history and entities.

data_description.printer_name: Leave empty to use the printer's model, e.g. Bambu Lab A1 mini.
data_description.access_code: 8 characters, shown on the printer's screen.

alerts.title: Watch prints
alerts.description: Warnings while a print is running. You get a notification in Home Assistant and the event `fdm_printer_manager_alert` (for your own automations). Nothing is ever resumed automatically.

data_description.alerts: Printer down in the middle of a print, interrupted or stuck print, no progress.
data_description.down_minutes: Warn when the printer stops answering during a print for this long.
data_description.close_minutes: A print still open while the printer answers but does not print (it came back without resuming, or the state got stuck) is closed as failed after this long.
data_description.stall_minutes: Warn when the progress has not moved for this long while printing. 0: never.
data_description.notify_services: Optional. Notify actions, separated by commas, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone, notify.mobile_app_tablet.

finish.title: When a print ends
finish.description: Optional. Besides the event `fdm_printer_manager_print_finished`. Google Sheets only writes to a spreadsheet created by its own integration.

data_description.todo_entity: Adds "Remove the print from [printer name]" with the file name and the result, so a part is not forgotten on the plate.
data_description.end_script: Started with the print summary as variables: printer, name, result, duration_s, energy_kwh, electricity_cost, currency.
data_description.sheets_config_entry: Adds one row per finished, failed or cancelled print to the spreadsheet of this Google Sheets integration entry. Empty: off.
data_description.sheets_worksheet: Name of the tab to write to. It must already exist: the Google Sheets button of the FDM Printers page creates it for you. Empty: Prints.

error.unsupported_energy_unit: Unsupported unit (expected Wh, kWh or MWh).
error.unsupported_price_unit: Unsupported unit (expected e.g. EUR/kWh, c€/kWh, EUR/MWh).
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the IP address and that the printer is on.
error.invalid_auth: Refused: check the access code (Bambu Lab) or the API key (Klipper).
error.price_required: Type the price per kWh (or pick a price entity): the plug measures energy.

mark_print.name: Mark a print
mark_print.description: Mark a finished print as a success or a failure. Use it when the printer got it wrong, e.g. a "finished" print that came off the plate.

entry_id.name: Printer
entry_id.description: The printer the print was made on.

job_id.name: Print ID
job_id.description: Optional. The print to mark (the `job_id` of the print history). Empty: the last print.

babystep.name: Baby step
babystep.description: Move the nozzle up or down while a Klipper printer prints (live Z offset), put the offset back to 0, or keep it.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Up: further from the bed. Down: closer to the bed.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Put the Z offset back to 0.

save.name: Save
save.description: Keep the offset (Z_OFFSET_APPLY_PROBE / ENDSTOP). Needs "Allow saving the Z offset" in the options; run SAVE_CONFIG when idle.

sheets_setup.name: Set up the Google Sheets log
sheets_setup.description: Adds one row per finished print to a tab of a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Creates the tab when it is missing and sets it in the options of every printer (or of one).

config_entry.name: Google Sheets entry
config_entry.description: The spreadsheet, as an entry of the Google Sheets integration. Empty: the first one.

worksheet.name: Worksheet
worksheet.description: Name of the tab. Created when it is missing. Empty: Prints.

entry_id.name: Printer
entry_id.description: Optional. Only this printer. Empty: every printer.
